dataset.name: Impact-branch qualification closure and future-track separation
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9L, read only the already validated local result artifacts needed for a traceable impact-branch qualification matrix, and separate numerical controls from physical qualifications. V9M acquires no source, performs no web search, executes no solver, fits no material or failure law, substitutes no generic material, runs no Blender process and makes no physical facade or global-impact claim.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A value or boolean read directly from a previously registered local result artifact, with its path recorded.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A value transcribed in a preserved prior result from an official source or model; V9M does not independently reproduce it.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: None introduced. The source archive is not read or rescanned in V9M.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The unchanged 10 percent numerical gate, the qualification categories and the future-track reopening rules.
evidence_policy.derived_result: The row classification, qualification counts, closed-gate decision and future-track state produced from the cached checks.
evidence_policy.contradiction_or_unknown: A required physical datum, benchmark property or convergence result that remains absent, failed or unresolved.

qualification_rows.result_summary: The frozen base case gives 25.475462528 MN-s total momentum and a 0.239975469 s tail-clearance estimate, within 0.010024531 s of the approximately 0.25 s official scale.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Scene timing, trajectory envelope and uncertainty storyboard inputs.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: No facade force, penetration, fragmentation, fuel dispersion or structural-damage validation.

qualification_rows.result_summary: The official OpenRadioss installation smoke case and source-hash gate passed.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Confirm that a bounded Radioss deck can be launched and checked locally.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: Software execution does not validate WTC-specific materials, contact, rupture or impact physics.

qualification_rows.result_summary: All three free-flight meshes passed the pre-impact stability, momentum, mass and zero-erosion checks after the V8V self-contact defect was corrected.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Preserve the minimal deformable projectile's pre-contact numerical stability as a regression.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: Free flight does not qualify projectile-facade contact or rupture.

qualification_rows.result_summary: With element erosion disabled, the diagonal contact impulse changes by 1.95062 percent from 50 to 25 mm.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Localize the dominant sensitivity to the unregularized deletion law rather than to basic contact execution alone.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: Deleting rupture physics cannot qualify a real deformable impact.

qualification_rows.result_summary: The rigid-sphere surrogate executes, but its 50-to-25 mm impulse difference is 20.9001 percent and fails the fixed 10 percent gate.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: No physical facade-impact validation and no aircraft representation.

qualification_rows.result_summary: After free-flight stabilization, the deformable eroding case still has a 32.8659 percent 50-to-25 mm impulse difference.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Diagnose the remaining post-contact mesh sensitivity.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: No converged projectile breakup or facade impulse.

qualification_rows.result_summary: The 50-to-25 mm impulse difference falls to 8.3414 percent with LeMAX=100 mm, while the 100-to-50 mm step remains 33.4297 percent and the length is not measured.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Show that a regularized deletion formulation can improve one tested numerical step.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: The chosen internal length and failure strains are not physical WTC or CF6 properties.

qualification_rows.result_summary: At fixed 50 mm mesh, LeMAX=50, 100 and 200 mm changes facade impulse from 134.731 to 153.224 to 216.738 kN-s; the maximum difference is 37.8369 percent.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Demonstrate that fracture length or energy must be independently bounded before physical use.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: No objective rupture prediction or tuned facade impulse.

qualification_rows.result_summary: Only 2 of 9 minimum WTC fracture-card requirements and 0 of 9 production CF6-80A2/cowling requirements are available.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Document the exact-data gap and retain published strength-rate observations as limited comparators.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: No generic alloy substitution, joint-failure assumption or calibrated aircraft breakup.

qualification_rows.result_summary: Two of five documentary requirements are complete; the S355 dataset remains a no-imputation descriptive comparator without absolute bar-DIC alignment.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: No WTC/CF6 material fit, stress-strain reconstruction or fracture-law substitution.

qualification_rows.result_summary: Neither the Altair rigid-sphere deck nor FAA AR-08/36 combines measured validation, deformable-projectile rupture, objective regularization, convergence and a reusable bounded deck.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Retain both sources as method comparators and stop the bounded search.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: Search closure does not prove that no suitable benchmark exists anywhere.

qualification_rows.result_summary: A future 3D storyboard may illustrate frozen kinematics and uncertainties, but no Blender run or physical interpretation occurs in V9M.
qualification_rows.permitted_use: Illustrative scene planning with explicit uncertainty overlays and permanent non-validation labels.
qualification_rows.prohibited_inference: No physical simulation, damage validation or solver coupling.

future_tracks.purpose: Create a clearly labelled illustrative storyboard from the frozen V8S less-severe, base and more-severe kinematic envelopes.
permitted_inputs: V8S frozen mass, speed, orientation and timing envelopes
already documented geometry and official damage outlines only when their provenance is shown
explicit uncertainty bands and alternative scene branches
mandatory_labels: No predicted force, rupture, debris trajectory or structural response
Blender is not a physics-validation tool in this project
prohibited_outputs: validated damage mask or debris field

future_tracks.purpose: Reopen physical impact qualification only after new primary evidence closes every controlling rupture, material, joint, benchmark and convergence gap.

required_triggers.requirement: Traceable impact-zone plate, weld, bolt, window and floor-attachment definitions with relevant rate and failure data.
Traceable CF6-80A2 core, cowling and attachment material/failure definitions at relevant rates.
A physical fracture-energy or internal-length bound identified independently of facade impulse.
A lawful deck or deterministic reconstruction with measured outputs, deformable-projectile rupture and an objective failure treatment.
A common measured observable on three comparable meshes with medium-to-fine eroding impulse difference no greater than 10 percent and a bounded fracture-length sensitivity no greater than 10 percent.

future_tracks.source_policy: Do not resume broad web searching. Evaluate only a newly identified primary source or user-supplied local evidence against the unchanged gates.
future_tracks.foia_policy: Last resort only; no request is sent and no external contact is made in V9M.

next_iteration.objective: Prepare a visualization-only 3D storyboard specification from the frozen V8S kinematic envelopes, with three uncertainty branches, explicit provenance for every geometric input and permanent non-physical-validation overlays. Do not execute Blender or any solver in V9N; keep the physical track dormant unless genuinely new primary evidence is supplied.
